# Packard Promo — Tanzania's Printing, Signage & Promotional Products Platform

## About
Packard Promo is a division of Packard Limited, established in 2010 in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It is Tanzania's leading printing, signage, packaging and promotional products platform with 14+ years of experience, 4,500+ projects delivered, 1,200+ signage installations, 350+ branding projects, and a 99% on-time delivery rate. Packard Promo serves 250+ organizations across 8+ Tanzanian cities from a 12,000 sqm production facility.

## Services (9 Categories)
1. Digital Printing — Business cards, flyers, brochures, posters, stickers, certificates, letterheads, ID cards. HP Indigo and Konica Minolta presses. Same-day turnaround available.
2. Offset Printing — Books, magazines, annual reports, bulk brochures, company profiles, educational materials, NCR receipt books. Heidelberg Speedmaster presses. 2,000 to 1,000,000+ unit runs.
3. Large Format Printing — PVC banners, roll-up banners, teardrop banners, backdrops, billboards. Up to 5m wide seamless printing.
4. Packaging Printing — Folding cartons, product packaging, food packaging, retail packaging, gift boxes, shopping bags, labels. Food-safe inks, FSC-certified board.
5. Signage Solutions — Shop signboards, 3D signs, outdoor signage, reception signs, safety signage, wayfinding, lightboxes, glass branding, retail storefronts. 5-7 year durability.
6. Vehicle Branding — Full wraps, partial wraps, decals, wheel covers. 3M IJ180Cv3 and Avery Dennison MPI 1105 vinyl. 5-7 year outdoor durability.
7. Promotional Products — T-shirts, polo shirts, caps, mugs, pens, uniforms, key holders, water bottles, power banks. Screen print, DTG, embroidery, sublimation.
8. Exhibition & Events — Pop-up displays, backdrops, event branding, registration counters, stage backdrops.
9. Design Studio — Logo design, graphic design, packaging design, signage design.
